text:
alec: hitting the node quickstart with a service account from an invite-only workspace. first request returns 402 Payment Required even though I thought trial credits apply.

alec: curl: ```bash
curl -s -D - -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer SA-ABC" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hi"}'
```

alec: response header: HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required; body: {"error":"payment_required","message":"Workspace billing not set up"}

devon_devex: thanks. quick checklist: 1) did you accept billing in the console after joining via invite? 2) is the SA token scoped to the same org as the workspace?

alec: i didn't add a card because I expected trial. SA is sa-abc from org_210. workspace id is org_210.

devon_devex: invite-created orgs need billing handshake to provision trial credits. add card then run `@billing-bot refresh org_210`. edge caches can return 403 or 402 while the flag propagates.

alec: added card and ran @billing-bot refresh org_210

billing-bot: queued tenant refresh for org_210 (ETA ~20s)

alec: retried ~40s later, now 200 OK and model responded "hello". first successful call. :tada:

devon_devex: great! we'll add a note in quickstart about invite-workspace billing and include a link to the refresh endpoint. Also filing an SDK UX item to surface the raw error body for quicker debugging.

alec: thanks, closing.
